question: **Direction: Select the INCORRECTLY spelt word.**
solution:
The correct answer is **"Hierarchial."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The incorrect spelling in option 4 is missing the letter** "c".**
 
• The correct spelling is** "hierarchical"** with the letter **"c"** after the letter **"i"**.
 
• **"Hierarchical"** means of the nature of a hierarchy; arranged in order of rank. (अधिक्रमिक, प्रदानुक्रमिक)
 
 
• **Example**: *The military has a **hierarchical**__ rank structure.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 4.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: "Cognisant" **is a correctly spelled word, meaning aware or knowledgeable. (संज्ञाता, प्रज्ञाता, जानकार, अवगत)
 
• **Option 2: "Troublesome"** is a correctly spelled word, meaning causing difficulty or annoyance. ((लंबे समय तक) कष्‍टकर, पीड़ादायक)
 
• **Option 3: "Pathetic"** is a correctly spelled word, meaning causing feelings of sadness or pity. (दयनीय, करुणाजनक)
